title: Apple Responds To YouTubers' AI Lawsuit, Seeks Case Dismissal
description: Apple is seeking dismissal of a lawsuit from three YouTube channels alleging unauthorized use of copyrighted videos to train its AI models.

title: AI financial tools require structured data architecture to improve small business finances
description: AI financial tools fail for the $1M-$10M tier because data is built for tax compliance. Owners must fix financial architecture before expecting reliable insights.

title: AI may need clear boundaries to preserve human autonomy, commentary argues
description: A 2026 analysis calls for absolute, non-negotiable AI rules to replace U.S. slow regulatory approach. It warns that without them, market incentives could erode democratic stability.
